dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hi, I'd like to report two arguing men, they're shouting and pulling each others' clothes, I'm worried they will start fighting any moment.
{WHERE?}Ok, where are you calling from?
It's the car wash at [[ADDRESS]].
It's the car wash at 2608 Central Avenue.
It's the car wash at 5603 Menaul Boulevard.
It's the car wash at 2608 156 Indian School Road.
{DO YOU KNOW THEM?}Do you know either of these men?
No, I have no idea who they are. Haven't seen them here before. They scared all my customers off!
{WHAT'S YOUR NAME?}Ok, what is your name?
[[NAME]] I'm the owner
I'm Agnes Black, I'm the owner
{ANY WEAPONS?}Can you tell if they have any weapons?
I don't know... Hurry, it's getting violent.
{CALM THEM DOWN?}Have you tried to calm them down?

dialogOption.emotions: from a distance until the are you there part
dialogOption.texten: Uh... Guys! Calm down or else the police will come! . . . . . . . . . Are you there, sir? I think they don't wanna meet any policemen. They're running to a car.
{DESCRIBE THE CAR}Can you tell the make and model of the car?

dialogOption.emotions: would be nice if some tyre screeching was hearable
dialogOption.texten: A black SUV. They're driving away!
{PROBLEM SOLVED}Well, in that case your problem is solved.
{HOW DO THEY LOOK?} Can you tell me what the men look like? Are they white, black, hispanic?
Both are white and tall, wearing dark clothes.
{PLATE NUMBER?}Were you able to get the license plate number?
Not really, I don't see well.
{MAKE AND MODEL OF THE CAR?}Do you know the make and model of the SUV they left in?
No, sorry.
{I CAN'T HELP}In that case, I can't help.
{WE'LL LOOK FOR THEM}I understand. I'll have officers keep a look out for them.
Okay, bye!
Umm okay, thanks I guess. Bye!

reportElement.texten: A worried car wash owner reported a fight between two men.
The suspects might have been known fugitives, but due to the operator's decision, they ran away.
The suspects were caught by police and turned out to be known fugitives.
